Solara — (9.5) PULSAR

DRACO AND HYDRA

"Draco and Hydra — listen, listen"

[Verse 1]

Level forty-one

Two prisoners walking in the middle of the group

Nobody asked them to walk in the middle

They just did — because what else

Draco on the left — 300 fighters, still silent

Hydra on the right — 140 wizards, still counting the loss

They fought this crew at level 40

They remember how that went

Then someone sidled up

(it was Persy)

Then someone else came over

(it was Rion)

The two lowest bounties on the board

Started a conversation nobody expected

[Pre-Chorus]

“We have a proposition.”

“…we are prisoners.”

“You are traveling companions we haven’t named yet.”

“We destroyed your people.”

“You were defeated, yes.”

“…and?”

“And we have a proposition.”

[Chorus]

Draco and Hydra — listen, listen

One loss does not close the book

Draco and Hydra — stay close, stay close

You watch, you wait, you learn

Then you challenge — on your terms

[Verse 2]

“He never loses,” said Draco

“He has to,” said Rion, “everything has a ceiling”

“We have searched,” said Hydra, “a hundred years”

“You searched from the outside,” said Persy

“We are offering you the inside”

“The inside.”

“You are not his weakness.”

“Obviously.”

“His crew is not his weakness.”

“Clearly.”

“But something is.”

“And you would know this.”

“We would know this.”

“You. The assistant.”

“Persy.”

“…that is a name.”

“It is.”

“You. Persy. The—”

“Negotiator.”

“You are not a negotiator.”

“I am negotiating with you right now.”

(Draco had no answer for that)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

“You want us to travel with people who beat us.”

“I want you to travel with people who know the person who beat you.”

“And learn what exactly.”

“Everything.”

“And then.”

“And then you know things you didn’t know before.”

“And then we challenge.”

“…eventually.”

“When you’re ready.”

“We are always ready.”

“When you have information.”

(Hydra looked at Draco)

(Draco looked at Hydra)

[Chorus]

Draco and Hydra — the logic tracks though

Stay close, observe, and when the time is right —

But then again —

Draco and Hydra — yeah okay fine

Probably

Maybe

[Verse 3]

The rest of the crew had been listening

Cygnus from behind pretended not to hear

Cassie had stopped walking to hear better

Lara was hovering a little lower than usual

And from somewhere ahead

The Hero kept walking

Back to all of it

Pace exactly the same

(he heard everything)

(he had no opinions)

(he continued)

Persy leaned over to Rion and said nothing

Rion leaned back and said nothing

They waited

[Bridge]

Draco, low: “This is humiliating.”

Hydra, lower: “It is practical.”

Draco: “We lost to twelve.”

Hydra: “We will not lose again.”

Draco: “The negotiator convinced us.”

Hydra: “He made a sound argument.”

Draco: “I cannot believe he made a sound argument.”

Hydra: “Neither can I.”

Draco: “We tell no one.”

Hydra: “Who would believe us anyway.”

[Chorus]

Draco and Hydra — for research purposes

Draco and Hydra — this is not loyalty

Draco and Hydra — absolutely not joining

Just traveling

In the same direction

Probably

Maybe

[Outro]

Draco: “This is not loyalty.”

Hydra: “Agreed.”

Draco: “We are not joining.”

Hydra: “Absolutely not.”

Draco: “We are simply traveling in the same direction.”

Hydra: “For research purposes.”

Persy: “Welcome aboard.”

Herc: [still walking]

[fourteen sets of footsteps, level 44 ahead]
